'''Sergey Vasiliyevich Karasev''' ({{langx|ru|Серге́й Васильевич Карасёв}}, '''Karasyov'''; born October 26, 1993) is a Russian professional [[basketball]] player and the [[Captain (sports)|team captain]] for [[BC Zenit Saint Petersburg|Zenit Saint Petersburg]] of the [[VTB United League]].<ref>{{cite web |url=http://nbadraft.net/players/sergey-karasev |title=7 - Sergey Karasev |work=nbadraft.net |access-date=July 22, 2012}}</ref><ref>{{cite web |url=https://insider.espn.com/nba/draft/results/player/_/id/19785/sergey-karasev |title=Sergey Karasev 2013 NBA Draft Profile |work=ESPN.com |access-date=July 22, 2012}}</ref> He was drafted with the 19th pick in the [[2013 NBA draft]] by the [[Cleveland Cavaliers]].

==Professional career==

===Triumph Lyubertsy (2010–2013)===
After playing for the [[B.C. Zenit Saint Petersburg|Triumph Lyubertsy]] Under-23 team in 2009–10, Karasev joined the senior team for the 2010–11 [[Russian Professional Basketball League|PBL]] season. Karasev averaged 16.1 points per game during the [[2012–13 Eurocup Basketball|2012–13 season]] of the [[European professional club basketball system|2nd-tier European league]], the [[EuroCup Basketball|EuroCup]].<ref>[https://www.euroleaguebasketball.net/eurocup/players/?seasoncode=U2012&pcode=004302&clubcode=DYR KARASEV, SERGEY – Welcome to Eurocup]</ref> On April 3, 2013, Karasev decided to declare for the [[NBA draft]].<ref>[https://www.sbnation.com/nba/2013/4/3/4179664/nba-draft-2013-sergey-karasev-russia NBA Draft 2013: Russian guard Sergey Karasev declares]</ref>

===Cleveland Cavaliers (2013–2014)===
[[File:Sergey Karasev.jpg|thumb|left|upright|Karasev with the [[Cleveland Cavaliers]] in 2013]]
Karasev was selected with the 19th overall pick by the [[Cleveland Cavaliers]] in the [[2013 NBA draft]]. On August 20, 2013, he signed his rookie scale contract with the Cavaliers.<ref>[http://www.nba.com/cavaliers/news/draft-picks-130820 Cavaliers Sign 2013 Draft Picks to Contracts]</ref> During his rookie season, he had multiple assignments with the [[Canton Charge]] of the [[NBA G League|NBA Development League]].<ref>[http://www.nba.com/dleague/assignments_2013_14.html 2013-14 NBA Assignments]</ref>

===Brooklyn Nets (2014–2016)===
On July 10, 2014, Karasev was traded to the [[Brooklyn Nets]] in a three-team trade involving the Cavaliers and the [[Boston Celtics]].<ref>[http://www.nba.com/nets/news/brooklyn-nets-acquire-jarrett-jack-and-sergey-karasev Brooklyn Nets Acquire Jarrett Jack and Sergey Karasev]</ref> On October 24, 2014, the Nets exercised their third-year team option on Karasev's rookie scale contract, extending the contract through the 2015–16 season.<ref>[http://www.nba.com/nets/news/brooklyn-nets-exercise-options-plumlee-and-karasev Brooklyn Nets Exercise Options on Plumlee and Karasev]</ref> On March 11, 2015, he was ruled out for the rest of the 2014–15 season after being diagnosed with a dislocated [[patella]] and a torn [[Medial collateral ligament|MCL]] of the right knee, along with multiple loose bodies in the knee joint.<ref>[http://www.nba.com/nets/sergey-karasev-medical-update SERGEY KARASEV MEDICAL UPDATE]</ref>

On March 26, 2016, Karasev scored a career-high 17 points in a 120–110 win over the [[Indiana Pacers]].<ref>[http://www.nba.com/games/20160326/INDBKN/gameinfo.html Lopez scores 23 to lead Nets past Pacers 120-110]</ref>

===Zenit Saint Petersburg (2016–2019)===
On July 1, 2016, Karasev returned to Russia and signed a 2+1 deal with [[B.C. Zenit Saint Petersburg|Zenit Saint Petersburg]].<ref>{{cite news|title=Сергей Карасев продолжит карьеру в "Зените"|url=http://basket.fc-zenit.ru/news/ct217/70774.html|access-date=1 July 2016|work=basket.fc-zenit.ru|date=1 July 2016|language=ru}}</ref>

===BC Khimki (2019–2021)===
On July 1, 2019, Karasev signed a two-year contract with Russian club [[BC Khimki|Khimki]].<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.sport24.gr/Basket/Euroleague/eb-news/Khimki/ximki-apekthse-ton-karasef-mexri-to-2021.5549743.html|title=Χίμκι: Απέκτησε τον Καράσεφ μέχρι το 2021|last=Ιουλ. 2019 14:56|first=Επιμέλεια: Φάνης Παναγιώτου Δημοσίευση: 01|website=www.sport24.gr|language=en|access-date=2019-07-01|archive-date=2019-07-01|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20190701125636/https://www.sport24.gr/Basket/Euroleague/eb-news/Khimki/ximki-apekthse-ton-karasef-mexri-to-2021.5549743.html|url-status=dead}}</ref>

===Return to Zenit Saint Petersburg (2021–present)===
On June 7, 2021, Karasev officially returned to Zenit Saint Petersburg.<ref>{{cite web|title=Zenit brings back shooting guard Karasev|url=https://www.euroleaguebasketball.net/en/euroleague/news/zenit-brings-back-shooting-guard-karasev/|access-date=October 4, 2025|publisher=EuroLeague|date=June 7, 2021}}</ref>

==Russian national team==
Karasev was a regular Russian junior national team representative as he competed at the [[2009 FIBA Europe Under-16 Championship]], won a silver medal at the [[2010 FIBA Europe Under-18 Championship]], and a bronze medal at the [[2011 FIBA Under-19 World Championship|2011 FIBA Under-19 World Cup]].{{citation needed|date=March 2022}}

Karasev represented the [[Russia national basketball team|Russian senior national team]] for the first time at the [[Basketball at the 2012 Summer Olympics – Men's tournament|2012 Summer Olympics]] in [[London]].<ref>{{cite web|url=http://london2012.fiba.com/pages/eng/fe/12/olym/team/p/eid/6232/lid//rid//sid/6232/tid/381/profile.html|title=Team Russia Profile – 2012 Olympic Men|work=FIBA.com|access-date=October 22, 2013|url-status=dead|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20151125045915/http://london2012.fiba.com/pages/eng/fe/12/olym/team/p/eid/6232/lid//rid//sid/6232/tid/381/profile.html|archive-date=November 25, 2015}}</ref>

==Personal life==
Karasev is the son of former Russian international player and former [[BC Zenit Saint Petersburg|Zenit Saint Petersburg]] head coach, [[Vasily Karasev]].<ref>{{cite web |url=http://london2012.fiba.com/pages/eng/fe/10/fwcm/news/p/eid/6232/lid//nid/51438/rid//sid/6232/article.html |title=A great Russian tale |author=Taylor, Jeff |date=April 29, 2012 |work=FIBA.com |access-date=July 22, 2012 |url-status=dead |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20121119021534/http://london2012.fiba.com/pages/eng/fe/10/fwcm/news/p/eid/6232/lid/nid/51438/rid/sid/6232/article.html |archive-date=November 19, 2012 }}</ref> He also used to play under his father during his time with Triumph Lyubertsy, as well as for Russia's national team during [[EuroBasket 2013]].{{citation needed|date=March 2022}}
